experiment: Model pair on the frozen oneshot candidate (main 1f697d8, oneshot tree d31afba): deepseek-v4-flash vs kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed, local generations and local replays, 2026-09-23
formula: p=0 -> S=0; b<=1.2p -> S=p/(b/(1.2p))^0.1; b>1.2p -> S=p/(b/(1.2p))^0.2; p = combined passed/combined total in percent, b = combined cost in CNY
pairing: S is computed for every combination of one sample of each task (same model); S_mean is their mean. S_se is the first-order two-sample U-statistic standard error: SE^2 = var(row means)/n_a + var(column means)/n_b. Verdict: |S_mean(flash) - S_mean(kimi)| > S_se(flash) + S_se(kimi), otherwise indistinguishable.
cost_basis: gateway metered amount per call (exact match on model and input/output tokens); matches the local usage x price ledger for every completed call; cut or refused calls were not billed

Pass 1 (primary) ran after every generation ended; pass 2 is a robustness replay in reverse order.

exclusions.incident: Local proxy restart: Clash Verge Rev (the HTTPS_PROXY 127.0.0.1:7897 the agent's urllib uses, and the TUN) re-initialised at 13:58:55 CST (its latest.log starts with app initialisation at 13:58:55.217). Every in-flight model stream broke at 13:58:54 (StreamError) and each immediate retry failed within 4-6 ms (URLError), so the candidate's transport fallback switched each affected run to the other model. The gateway and the models were not at fault; the platform runner has no such proxy.
exclusions.rule: A sample is excluded from the primary comparison when any of its model calls was cut or refused by this incident; it is replaced by a new sample of the same model and task (d, e). Excluded samples stay in the per-sample table and in an as-run sensitivity analysis.

meter_rate_limit_note: Eight meter logins between 13:13 and 13:23 (every arcbench balance/models/requests command logs in) were followed by 429 on the ninth; after the switch to a local cost ledger and one in-process login per orchestrator with reads at most every 30 minutes, 3 of 3 reads succeeded.

incidents.effect: orchestrator 1 stopped launching after one generation; replaced by a local-ledger launch gate

incidents.what: local proxy restart: Clash Verge Rev re-initialised at 13:58:55 (its latest.log); every in-flight stream broke and retries were refused for about 2 s
incidents.effect: 4 samples switched model through the candidate's transport fallback; excluded from the primary comparison and replaced (d, e)
5 generations ran at once for 63 s; the fifth (flash-bookstack-e) was aborted after 64 s (unbilled) and relaunched at 14:10:04 as a fresh sample

incidents.what: network reset of every connection through the proxy node the gateway traffic uses (api.arc-bench.com matches the proxy's final rule, a Los Angeles node); other apps reconnected in the same second
incidents.effect: 4 in-flight calls cut; each retried once on the same model and completed; the samples stay in the primary comparison (flash-keep-d, flash-bookstack-d, flash-bookstack-e, kimi-keep-d), their wall time includes the lost attempt

incidents.what: other sessions on the same machine and account (agent-card generations and replays, repair_replay.py runs)
incidents.effect: their spend is separated by exact request matching; host load could affect the 12306 host replays, checked with calibration controls before and after pass 2

concurrency: at most 4 generations of this experiment at once, except 14:06:25-14:07:28 (5, see incidents)

12306_replay_checks.reading: Pass 2 reproduced pass 1 exactly for all four 12306 apps (51, 51, 79, 36) and both calibration controls replayed 74/135 = platform, so the 12306 local replay is deterministic here and host load from other sessions did not move it.

break_even.method: S at the per-task means; Kimi's 12306 mean at which its S equals flash's, holding each model's measured costs and the other task's mean; needed gain = (cost_kimi/cost_flash)^(1/11) - 1
